newsitem.title: UK: UK regulator starts review of East Mids bid.
newsitem.headline: UK regulator starts review of East Mids bid.

text.p: Britain's electricity industry regulator Offer said on Thursday it was circulating a consultation paper to seek views on the proposed acquisition by U.S. energy group Dominion Resources of UK regional electricity company East Midlands Electricity.

In a statement, Offer, which works with the Office of Fair Trading on competition issues in the industry, said it was issuing its consultation paper on the regulatory issues involved and inviting comments from interested parties by November 22.
Dominion and East Midlands have said that they see no reason for their deal to be refered for full monopolies investigation, but some analysts say the situation is not so clear-cut.
